name: deepseek-harness
display_name: DeepSeek Harness / dsh (Ubuntu, non-A2A control group)
description: DeepSeek AI's open-source agent harness (dsh), built on an everything-is-a-plugin architecture and Cordis. Per the official README, npx @deepseek-harness/dsh web starts a Web UI at http://127.0.0.1:3080 by default; --no-open skips launching the browser. It does not implement A2A or publish an Agent Card (the Web UI and A2A JSON-RPC are different things). Currently a developer preview, so the API may change incompatibly. This entry is kept as a control group showing how a non-A2A asset is registered.

metadata.install: npx @deepseek-harness/dsh (from source: pnpm install && pnpm run build)
metadata.a2a: unsupported — the Web UI on :3080 is not an A2A server; see example/README_cn.md for how the control group is marked
